full_required_dependencies.assessment: Host-owned immutable CodingTask validation/digests/defaults/scopes/flags and historical named baseline definitions; discovered immediate task owner and authenticated from initial inventory before expanded body review.

reviewed.assessment: Fixed installed API allowlist, signatures/docstrings/package versions and digest; no arbitrary model import/call.
Scoped NUL Git state; existing bundle composition; saved report/payload/bundle authentication and freshness; independent review authority remains external.

Full preparation/_turns/finalization bodies: both modes, call/proposal/action/context bounds, source provenance, effect/validation feedback, candidate/restoration/accounting; one new post-acceptance failure P2.
Shared fixed selectors, bound validation inputs/config/runners, reserved evidence names, before/between/after checks, cancellation/logs and AST-equivalent optional format.
Complete schema/argument, snapshot/index, drift/alias, observation refresh/union, native read/lookup/expand/reference/API/absence/map paths and bounds.
Complete source/argument/envelope/diagnostic projection, same-version exact dedup/containment, correlated exchange eviction and budget refusal; no restart loader.

Complete active primitive helpers plus retained historical freezing/Markdown/upfront/structured runners. Distinguish actual CLI consumers from legacy paths and synthetic tests; no archived treatment executed.
Full path/reference/nested admission, duplicates, exact observed version/absence/API, all components before effects, overlap/newline/byte constraints and provenance.
Full explicit ToolDescriptor to ModelToolDefinition seam; lower strict JSON owners preserved.
Full canonical typed-core/map/ranking/Planning selection and exact source expansion, source cap and stale frame ownership.
Complete CLI, trusted host task/profile/source materialization/Checkout/closeout/exit behavior; no model-selected config/argv.
Full historical individual-input fixture/shims and baseline authentication override; no independent Devtools tree.
All fixtures/helpers/assertions; actual tiny Git and frozen individual inputs; real independent oracle and synthetic provider, cancellation, budget, immutable drift, native/refusal/source provenance.
All fixtures/assertions, real RI+ToolRunner+native worker; actual source/snapshot correspondence, ambiguity/refusal, projection/correlation; pure synthetic helper cases distinct.
All parameter/fixture bodies; exact Git/LF/CRLF/EOF controls, real Tool read/patch plus synthetic historical acceptance/preparation. Stubbed checks are not full validation proof.
Full CLI factory/argument/return fixtures and actual tiny Checkout/branch/newline/source restoration controls; service readiness/interaction mocked, not live.
